Here’s your week‑long, family‑friendly road trip plan from Chattanooga across three exciting Georgia cities, all under your $6,800 budget and with no flights:

| Day | City (or Route) | Transportation | Breakfast | Attractions | Lunch | Dinner | Accommodation |
|-----|-----------------|----------------|-----------|-------------|-------|--------|---------------|
| 1 | **from Chattanooga to Atlanta** | Rental car, 3‑hr drive | Bluebird Café, Chattanooga; Sun Diner, Atlanta | Chattanooga Lookout Mountain, Chattanooga; MLK Jr. National Historic Site, Atlanta | Puckett’s Grocery & Restaurant, Atlanta | Ponce City Market Dining, Atlanta | Hyatt Regency Atlanta |
| 2 | **Atlanta** | Car (city) | Sunny Diner, Atlanta | Georgia Aquarium, Atlanta; World of Coca‑Cola, Atlanta | Ponce City Market, Atlanta | P.F. Chang’s, Atlanta | Hyatt Regency Atlanta |
| 3 | **from Atlanta to Savannah** | Rental car, 4‑hr drive | Café 77, Atlanta; The Greenhouse Café, Savannah | Savannah Historic District, Savannah; Forsyth Park, Savannah | Mrs. Wilkes’ Dining Room, Savannah | The Olde Pink House, Savannah | Historic Inns of Savannah |
| 4 | **Savannah** | Car (city) | The Collins Quarter, Savannah | Savannah Children’s Museum, Savannah; River Street, Savannah | Bubba’s Restaurant, Savannah | The Crab Shack, Tybee Island | Historic Inns of Savannah |
| 5 | **from Savannah to Athens** | Rental car, 2‑hr drive | The Breakfast Club, Savannah; Athens Coffee, Athens | UGA campus, Athens; State Botanical Garden of Georgia, Athens | Red Clay Café, Athens | The Tamale Shop, Athens | Marriott Athens Downtown |
| 6 | **Athens** | Car (city) | Reuben’s Deli, Athens | Georgia Museum of Art, Athens; Athens Botanical Garden, Athens | The Waving Olive, Athens | The Olde Towne, Athens | Marriott Athens Downtown |
| 7 | **from Athens to Chattanooga** | Rental car, 6‑hr drive | Breakfast at Lunch, Athens; Bluebird Café, Chattanooga | Waynesville, TN stop; Chattanooga Riverfront, Chattanooga | McDonald’s, Chattanooga | Chattanooga Chili Bowl, Chattanooga | Suite at Chattanooga Inn |

All accommodations are entire rooms, family‑friendly, and budget‑conscious. Enjoy the scenic drives, historic sites, and kid‑friendly dining spots along the way!

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
